remarks: Established Turnkey Floral Business - Built-In Online Revenue Channels! An exceptional opportunity to acquire an established, turnkey floral business with existing operations and a proven business model. A substantial majority of business revenue is generated through established online floral networks, including nationally recognized companies such as 1-800-Flowers, providing access to a broad customer base and consistent order opportunities beyond the local market. This business offers an established foundation for a new owner to step in and continue operations while benefiting from existing online relationships and revenue channels. There is also tremendous potential to expand through direct online marketing, local business partnerships, weddings, special events, and corporate accounts. Ideal for an experienced florist looking to expand or an entrepreneur seeking an established business with existing revenue streams and room for growth. Skip the startup phase and take advantage of an established business with built-in online order channels and exciting growth potential!
